provenance_policy: Every entry cites the verbatim scope phrase it expands and gives a reason why it is equivalent. No entry was chosen by inspecting the fixture's suggestion columns or the held-out answer key. Reasons reference only public NITRD scope definitions, the AI statutory definition (15 U.S.C. 9401(3)), or the cross-PCA guidance on the NITRD FY2025 PCA page.
